cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Gold labels for the fine-tuning set are computed by verifiable arithmetic over WFP VAM's structured African market price data, not LLM-judged distillation.

test_prompts.prompt: One trader offers rice at 1,200 XOF for a 25 kg bag. Another offers 2,000 XOF for a 50 kg bag. Which is cheaper per kilo?
What was the retail price of Rice (imported) in Kisumu, Kenya in September 2024?
